Provide the data of gt_radmix() for a class (for package developers)

Source: R/radmix_data.R
gt_radmix_data.Rd

gt_radmix() reads the data of x through gt_radmix_data(), a generic with a method for a tidypopgen::gen_tibble. Packages that store their data differently can provide methods for their own classes: this is how gt_radmix() fits genotype likelihoods, without tidygenclust depending on the packages that store them. Users do not need to call it.

Usage

gt_radmix_data(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
gt_radmix_data(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'gen_tbl'
gt_radmix_data(x, use_imputed = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

the object given to gt_radmix()

...

further arguments for methods

use_imputed

boolean; for a gen_tibble, whether imputed genotypes should be used, as in gt_radmix()

Value

a list (see the details)

Details

A method for genotype likelihoods returns a list with the elements:

  • kind: "gl_source";

  • version: 1L, the version of the interface;

  • fill: an external pointer (made with R_MakeExternalPtrFn()) to a C function that fills the likelihoods of a block of individuals at one locus, tagged with the symbol tidygenclust_gl_fill;

  • ctx: an external pointer to the data that the function reads (its context);

  • n_indiv, n_loci: the numbers of individuals and loci, in the order of the rows of x and of tidypopgen::show_loci() (which label the rows of Q and of P);

and any other element that must stay alive while gt_radmix() uses the source (e.g. the file-backed matrix that the context points into). The C function is specified in the header include/tidygenclust/radmix_gl_source.h of the installed package, which a package can copy (or use with LinkingTo: tidygenclust): it gives the likelihoods of 1 and 2 copies of allele2 relative to that of 0 copies, and whether each individual has data, and it is called from several threads, so it must not call R. The file src/radmix_gl_source.cpp of tidygenclust's sources is an example, used by its tests. P then gives the frequency of allele2. Starts from the SVD and imputed genotypes are not available for genotype likelihoods: gt_radmix() checks them itself, and calls a method with x alone (use_imputed is only given to the method for a gen_tibble, when it is TRUE).

The list for a gen_tibble is internal to tidygenclust, and may change.

See also

gt_radmix(), whose details describe the model of genotype likelihoods
